text.title: The **Intraday Decision Tree**
text.body:
Part 1: The Open
with Dr. Ken Long

segments.label: Agenda card

text.title: Seven chapters, about 48 minutes
text.body:
Why the open is a critical state | the gap stat, the stats, RangeStat
The root of the tree | big gap, no gap, or not trading the open
Small or no gap: the O3 | the three-minute bar, and its size against the R10
Big gap: the bracket | a box on both sides, the stop at the open
Gap fails, gap holds, the morning hook | the pattern he calls his favorite
Opening inside yesterday | the yellow zone and the narrow-day filter
The first hour | where the day's high or low is set
